# bc7enc16 decoder

`bc7decomp.c` and `bc7decomp.h` from [bc7enc16](https://github.com/richgel999/bc7enc16): the BC7 decoder by Harm Hanemaaijer (ISC, `LICENSE`), unmodified. The texture generator decodes its BC7 output with it to check the quality gate. The bc7enc16 compressor itself is not kept; `port/third_party/bc7enc` encodes.
